Pastrami on white with mayo.d: Steamed until glossy and piled high on soft sandwich bread with mayonnaise, iceberg lettuce and sliced tomato.
Pastrami on white with mayo.note: Yes, we make it. Max the counterman winces.

Alvy's potato knishes.d: Flaky pastry around a mash of boiled Idahos and onions fried slow in butter, egg-washed and baked golden.
Alvy's potato knishes.note: Same recipe as our first counter in Coney Island.

Lobster bites.d: Sweet cooked meat folded with mayonnaise, lemon, diced celery and chives, piled on rounds of buttered, toasted brioche.
Lobster bites.note: Cooked and shelled for you. No chasing them round the kitchen.

New York cheesecake.d: Cream cheese, sour cream and lemon zest on a buttery crumb crust, baked slow in a water bath and chilled overnight.
New York cheesecake.note: Whole cakes 9.50 with a day's notice.

Alvy's LA cucumber mint cooler.d: Fresh cucumber, lime, mint and honey, strained and poured over ice, topped up with seltzer.
Alvy's LA cucumber mint cooler.note: Big in Los Angeles, we hear. We wouldn't know.
